snippet.title: Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Reynardo's back in Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure, a new entry in the popular fantasy action Stories series. 

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4185200/Ever_After_Again_A_Stories_Adventure/

Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure returns to the fairytale world of critically acclaimed 2016 hit Stories: The Path of Destinies. The happily-ever-after that swashbuckling fox hero Reynardo won ten years ago has not gone entirely to plan, and when an even greater threat rises, he must pick up his cutlass and delve into the mystical Book of Destinies once more.

– Guide Reynardo through branching and looping adventures shaped by your choices
– Fight with finesse in an overhauled combat system that combines melee, ranged weapons and magical powers
– Each death (It happens. A lot) reveals new consequences, secrets and possibilities 
– Skip to crucial decision points to reduce repetitive playthroughs

Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure is currently in development for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4185200/Ever_After_Again_A_Stories_Adventure/

Wishlist on PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10019971
